component.title: ApprovalPrompt
component.purpose: Make high-stakes human approval legible, scoped, reversible where possible, and recoverable.

states.description: A scoped action awaits an explicit decision.
The approval request is being recorded without changing its scope.
The request failed and exposes a truthful retry.
The actor lacks permission and receives an explained recovery path.
A recoverable request is ready to retry with unchanged scope.

claims.statement: The exact action, target, and scope are rendered immediately before the approval control.
Approval is a native keyboard-operable action without automatic focus capture.
Request errors and permission denial preserve context and expose distinct recovery paths.
The decision surface remains readable across the declared kits and dark mode.
